# Feature request

## Module

Which LuiExtended module should this belong to? See [MODULES.md](https://github.com/DakJaniels/LuiExtended/blob/master/docs/MODULES.md) (Unit Frames, Action Bar, Buffs/Debuffs, Combat Info, Combat Text, Chat Announcements, Info Panel, Slash Commands, MiniMap, Core/Misc).

## Platform

- [ ] PC (keyboard/mouse UI)
- [ ] Console (gamepad UI)
- [ ] Both

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Example: "I cannot tell when X happens during Y content."

## Proposed solution

What should happen instead? Include settings or UI behavior if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Screenshots, ability IDs, links to similar add-ons, or related GitHub issues.
